class.name: IfcPhysicalComplexQuantity
class.brief_description: The complex physical quantity, IfcPhysicalComplexQuantity , is an entity that holds a set of single quantity measure value (as defined at the subtypes of IfcPhysicalSimpleQuantity ), that all apply to a given component or aspect of the element. EXAMPLE: A layered element, like a wall, may have several material layers, each having individual quantities, like footprint area, side area and volume. An

members.member: Set of physical quantities that are grouped by this complex physical quantity according to a given discrimination.
Identification of the discrimination by which this physical complex property is distinguished. Examples of discriminations are 'layer', 'steel bar diameter', etc.
Additional indication of a quality of the quantities that are grouped under this physical complex quantity.
Additional indication of a usage type of the quantities that are grouped under this physical complex quantity.
